title: Al-Arabiyyah Bayna Yadayk (Book 1)
description: Complete video lectures for the beginner Arabic textbook used at Islamic University of Madinah, teaching Arabic as a second language. This course covers the foundational lessons of Al-Arabiyyah Bayna Yadayk (العربية بين يديك) with Ustadh Abdul Karim from Green Lane Masjid, UK.
short_description: Beginner Arabic course using the Islamic University of Madinah textbook

lessons.content: Arabic alphabet - the letters and their sounds, from Green Lane Masjid's Al-Arabiyyah Bayna Yadayk Book 1 series (Ustadh Abdul Karim).

lessons.title: Lesson 1b - Arabic Alphabet Practice
lessons.content: Continued practice of Arabic alphabet recognition and pronunciation

lessons.content: Greetings and introductions in Arabic from Green Lane Masjid's Al-Arabiyyah Bayna Yadayk Book 1 series (Ustadh Abdul Karim).
